title: Science Formulation Wave 013 — Reconstruction, Filtering, Commutation and Dark-Sector Closure
purpose: Record a formulation-focused science pass that improves existing theories by adding exact constraints, derivations and failure tests rather than expanding the ontology with more named entities.

records.main_contribution: Replaces an undefined cross-dimensional information invariant with task sufficiency, reconstruction distortion, a fiber-ambiguity lower bound and data-processing losses along a projection ladder.
records.strongest_result: For any decoder on a projection fiber, worst-case reconstruction error is at least half the fiber diameter; task preservation is instead characterized by I(Z;X|Y)=0.

records.main_contribution: Turns Starchforce storage/release into an explicit one-pole dynamical filter with impulse response, transfer function, phase lag and parameter-identifiability cases.
records.strongest_result: Stock-only measurements identify eta+Gamma but cannot separate release eta from loss Gamma; calibrated release measurements can in principle separate them under the model.

records.main_contribution: Introduces the Axis/time Lie bracket, assume-guarantee Door contracts, viability compatibility and an observable-equivalence criterion for model reduction.
records.strongest_result: [F,A] measures whether structural/Axis flow and time evolution commute; a nonzero bracket means their order changes predictions and they cannot be treated as independent operations without modeling the coupling.

records.main_contribution: Defines a typed defect vector for reconstruction loss, task-information loss, noncommutation, observable-reduction error, Door coarse-graining error, contract violation and predictive loss.
records.strongest_result: The theories can share a rigor language without being claimed to share a physical ontology.

records.main_contribution: Selects one explicit Q=xi H rho_c interacting-dark-sector benchmark, solves the background analytically and makes the perturbation-closure problem explicit.
records.strongest_result: A background interaction law does not determine growth perturbations until a covariant transfer four-vector, momentum-transfer frame, sound-speed/field assumptions and stability prescription are specified.

shared_upgrade_pattern: Replace an undefined invariant with a conditional or task-specific one.
Replace a qualitative flow with a transfer function or vector field.
Replace symbolic compatibility with a contract or commutator test.
Replace model menus with one nested benchmark that has an exact null limit.
Make failure/underidentification a first-class model outcome.
next_best_contributions: Apply the 11D task-sufficiency framework to one explicit synthetic high-dimensional projection and calculate Delta_task versus D_rec.
Fit the Spudlight one-pole versus two-pole storage model to an actual public time-series domain where input and stock/release are measured.
Construct a small Potato Dynamics example with explicit F and A and calculate [F,A] analytically, then verify the finite-flow order defect numerically.
Complete perturbation equations for exactly one Cosmic Soil coupling prescription or stop at background level rather than mixing incompatible perturbation choices.
relationship_to_other_waves: Wave 010 improved rigor and completion standards; Wave 011 selected promising calculable benchmarks; Wave 012 defines a deeper mixed research programme; Wave 013 focuses specifically on mathematical formulation and contributes reusable exact constraints to existing theories.
